title: US Divorce Fell to 2.4 per Thousand Annually
hook: US divorce fell to 2.4 people per thousand.
closing: Later marriage tracks with fewer breakups, so the old divorce scare is outdated.
question: How old were your parents when married?

segments.say: US divorce fell to 2.4 people per thousand, nearly halving as later marriage became more common.
Women now first marry at a median age of 28.6, and later marriage tracks with fewer breakups.
